pick.headline: Soviet fighter shoots down Korean Air Lines Flight 007
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of September 1, 1983, listed under Northeast Asia a South Korean airliner "reported missing," Soviet denials (via KYODO) that it had landed on Sakhalin or was in Soviet territory, and an item that Soviet air space had been "violated."

alternates.headline: Reagan proposes his Middle East peace plan
alternates.fbis: The Middle East & Africa contents for September 1982 listed reaction to the Reagan initiative: Israeli items from Peres, Begin's office and West Bank figures, an Algerian commentary on Reagan's "pacification plan," JANA on his TV speech, and Tunisia's Es-Sebsi calling it progress.
